description: How Mossmeal works  In vanilla Minecraft, using bone meal on a moss block only works when there is air above it — the moss patch spreads across the floor and grows grass, moss carpets and azaleas.

mods.name: Mossmeal
mods.description:
Bone meal on moss blocks now works on walls and ceilings too.
Ceilings sprout hanging glow berries of varying lengths instead of trees.
Cave vines stop growing at a random per-vine length and never reach the ground.

releases.notes:
Vine trimming (since 2.0.0)

Natural cave vine growth is limited everywhere: every vine gets its own stable random maximum length (2–5 blocks) and never grows closer than 2 air blocks above the ground. Caves get varied, decorative hangings instead of uniform curtains. Already generated or placed vines are left untouched — only further growth stops.
